name: kairoku
description: Connect a session to the Kairoku app over MCP (OAuth browser sign-in, no pasted tokens), with the protocol skills — jira-ops, git-pr, kairoku-mcp — and the four orchestration role agents the daemon drives: implementer, reviewer, planner, researcher. The roles read the target repo's own `AGENTS.md`/`CLAUDE.md` and `.kairoku/patterns.md` before their first write.

kairoku_url.title: Kairoku app URL
kairoku_url.description: Base URL of your Kairoku deployment. Defaults to https://kairoku.io; sign in through /mcp → Authenticate.
